description: List the apps in Speak's automation catalog: Speak's built-in apps plus, when enabled, every third-party app available through Composio, with its connection state and connected accounts for this user. Each app says what it brings in (pull: its triggers start an automation and can import files) and what it sends out (push: its actions take Speak's results). Read-only: the list comes from Speak's own catalog and the user's saved connections. Use the app slugs with list_automation_triggers and list_automation_actions. An app that is not connected must be connected in the Speak web app first.

for.description: "trigger" lists only apps that can start an automation (pull), "action" only apps that can take its results (push). Omit for all apps.
